name: the sandbox's sandbox tier
plain: Sand, in a box. Throw something at it and the grains move because they push on each other.

carrier.state: a quadtree of holons over a square domain; the terminal holon is one grain of sand. Evaluator: GranularContact (grain-on-grain unilateral contact with Coulomb friction)

not_claimed: The code calls this a tier of its zoom ladder. No closure or carriage is certified in this format, so its standing here is `rung`.
Nothing relates this tier to the one below it beyond the ladder's order: `below` is context.
